blocks: Happy Tails’ rate sheet includes grooming options for dogs weighing up to 99 lb, plus a separate doodle category. It doesn’t list a size category above 99 lb, so I can’t confirm grooming for dogs over that weight. The groomer also assesses coat and care needs before giving a final quote.
